remaining_limitations: Vercel deployment ID and source commit unknown because provider console required unavailable login.
Render deployment ID/source commit and live provider healthCheckPath unknown; only checked-in render.yaml was inspected.
No deployed record with explicit retrieval_unavailable historical evidence was available.
Fresh credential re-entry was not repeated because the in-app responsive view did not expose a usable sign-out control.
Screenshots were displayed inline by the browser tool but not materialized to repository PNG files; screenshot_evidence.md indexes those captures.
Acceptance demonstrates application behavior only; it does not establish model accuracy, calibrated probability, or production safety.
